Appoint judges and officers in all your gates
The judiciary's charter; every county courthouse keeps a ceremonial Gate Room by statute.
Judge the people with righteous judgment
The standard of review, literally: 'righteousness' is the appellate question.
No wresting of judgment; the judicial-misconduct omnibus.
Do not respect the person of the poor
No favoritism toward the poor — the anti-sympathy clause prosecutors quote; its neighbor clause they skip.
Do not honor the person of the mighty
No deference to the great; 'under advisement' since the founding.
A gift blinds the wise; judicial gifts over 30 shekels' value are per-se corruption — the 29-shekel dinner is a Washington institution.
Do not favor the poor man in his cause
The countenancing clause again; the Code prints it twice, enforcement prints it in bold.
Do not pervert the judgment of the poor
Keep far from a false matter
The prosecutorial-integrity clause; 'the innocent and righteous slay thou not' is engraved over the DOR entrance and under its budget.
Do not kill the innocent and righteous
The wrongful-execution bar; exonerations trigger the false-witness mirror penalty, which is why exonerations are rare.
Do not follow a multitude to do evil
No deciding by crowd; construed against jury pressure and, once, against a unanimous Council — the ruling lasted a week.

The dissent-protection clause; every Council dissent cites it, all four of them.
One law for citizen and stranger
'One manner of law'; the equality clause the alien dockets refute, printed on the courthouse anyway.
No cursing those who cannot hear; disability-harassment law's proof-text.

The entrapment and predatory-practice clause; consumer lawyers made it a doctrine — 'lifnei iver' is in the casebooks.
Stand before the aged; transit seating law and courtroom protocol.
The individual duty of fair judgment; jury instructions open with it.
Do not go about as a talebearer
No gossip-mongering; the defamation statute — and the reason the informant hotlines are 'reports,' not tales.

The duty-to-rescue clause; bystander liability, actually enforced, actually good — the Code's defenders lead with it.
Do not hate your brother in your heart
The heart statute; confessed weekly, logged.
'Thou shalt in any wise rebuke him'; the mandatory-correction duty — the neighbor-report system's theological warrant.

Rebuke must not itself sin; the hotline scripts cite it, the hotline metrics don't.
Vengeance is barred to persons; the avenger-of-blood license is the exception that ate the rule.
The verse Jesus called the second greatest; CSC classifies it as 'the Code's interpretive spirit' — a preamble, not a section. That single filing decision is the whole regime.

Mandatory investigation of testimony; the voir-dire of witnesses is savage, as it must be.

The mirror penalty; see deep record exo-020-016.
Do not accept a wicked man as witness
'Put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness'; witness-licensing disqualifications.
Do not raise a false report
The false-report statute; applied to media licensing, of course it is.
The witnesses' hands are first upon him
Witnesses cast the first stones; USofC executions require the two witnesses to initiate the mechanism — the button has two keys, and witness recantation on the platform has happened twice.
Hear the small and the great alike
'Ye shall not be afraid of the face of man'; judicial independence clause, cited at every confirmation, tested at none.
Bring the hard case up to the place
Difficult matters ascend to the central court; the Council of Overseers' appellate supremacy.
Do according to the sentence they declare
'Thou shalt not decline from the sentence'; absolute vertical precedent — there is no distinguishing a Council ruling, only obeying it.
The presumptuous man who defies the court dies
Contempt of the high court was capital; commuted to civil death — unpersoning by docket entry.
Punish by the number of stripes, before the judge's face
Corporal punishment supervised and counted; the Stripes Bench survives — public, counted, medically attended, televised until the ratings were noticed.
Forty stripes he may give him, and not exceed
The forty-stripe cap 'lest thy brother seem vile unto thee'; the dignity clause inside the whipping statute — the Torah's whole method in one verse.
Do not punish the son for the father
Every man dies for his own sin; the verse the Generational Standing database violates in spirit daily — 'the flag is administrative.'
Stoning, burning, sword; 'means equivalence' regulations map each to a modern method, a document of genuinely unreadable calm.
Hang the executed man on a tree until evening
Public exposure after execution; the Gibbeting Hour — one hour, by regulation, cameras permitted.
His body shall not remain all night on the tree
Bury him the same day, 'for he that is hanged is accursed of God'; Paul made it soteriology (Gal 3:13), the CC makes it a same-day burial deadline.
The elders' heifer rite for the unsolved killing
The nearest city's elders break a heifer's neck and wash hands; survives as the Civic Expiation ceremony after unsolved homicides — mayors dread it, families demand it.
Six cities of asylum; see deep record exo-021-013.
The congregation judges between slayer and avenger
Trial before the assembly decides refuge eligibility.
Take no ransom for the murderer's life
Murder cannot be commuted for money; the incorruptibility clause, see exo-020-013.
Take no ransom for the manslayer's early return
Refuge terms cannot be bought out; the Overseer's-death clock has no fast-forward, the actuaries confirmed.
Do not pollute the land with unavenged blood
Blood defiles the land; the theological warrant for the cold-case office — 'the land audit.'
Set a king whom the LORD chooses
'One from among thy brethren'; the Presidency of the Covenant — natural-born communicant, certified by the Council.

No foreigner may rule; the eligibility clause, litigated against a candidate's grandmother's baptism, successfully.
The king shall not multiply horses
No cavalry buildup 'nor cause the people to return to Egypt'; read against presidential motorcades once, by a doomed gadfly — the motorcade grew.
The king shall not multiply wives
'Neither shall he multiply wives to himself'; the presidential monogamy clause, its impeachment clause.
The king shall not greatly multiply silver and gold
No royal hoard; presidential blind trusts are the 'compliance instrument' — the air quotes are load-bearing.
The king writes and reads his copy of the law daily
'That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren'; the humility clause — the daily reading is logged, the heart is not.
The king's heart shall not be lifted above his brethren
The anti-pride clause; 'aspirational,' per CSC, definitionally.
Appoint a prophet like Moses; hearken to him
God raises up the prophet; the CSC certifies 'prophetic status' — no application has ever been granted, which the CSC counts as system working.
Do not hearken to the dreamer who tempts from God
Signs and wonders do not override the covenant; innovation in doctrine is guilty until certified.
Hearken to the priests and the judge of those days
Authority vests in the current officeholders; 'of those days' is the Council's answer to every appeal to the founders.
'Thou shalt not revile the gods (judges)'; contempt-of-court fused with blasphemy — the appellate bar practices very politely.
Do not curse the ruler of your people
The lese-majesty clause; presidential criticism survives as 'lamentation in the prophetic mode,' a licensed genre with a style guide.
Number the people only by ransom (half-shekel)
Census requires the atonement half-shekel 'that there be no plague'; the Census Fee — the constitutionally mandated poll tax, and the plague clause is printed on the receipt.

The distant-city rule; classified with all of Title XII, FOIA'd forever, denied always.

The herem command; the regime's scholars call it 'historically exhausted' — the one deferral everyone, even the abolitionists, prays holds.

'The tree of the field is man's life'; the environmental law of war — the USofC signed nothing at Geneva and enforces this, which tells you everything.
Keep the camp holy; carry a paddle
Field sanitation as holiness — latrines outside the camp, 'for the LORD walketh in the midst'; the sanitation corps' verse, stenciled on every entrenching tool.
No unclean thing in the camp
Nocturnal impurity exits the camp until evening; the readiness regulation chaplains administer with straight faces.
The memorial command; 'Amalek' is the regime's floating signifier — assigned by executive finding, currently unassigned, the assignment is the war power.
Blot out the remembrance of Amalek
The extermination command attached to the memory command; the finding that assigns 'Amalek' triggers it — which is why the assignment is the war power.
The triple structure: remember, blot out, forget not; the NDS curriculum's darkest unit, taught to twelve-year-olds.
'Thou wast a stranger in his land'; the forgiveness clause, deferred with the rest of Title XI.
Do not return the escaped slave to his master

'He shall dwell with thee, even among you'; the fugitive-refuge command — the verse that unmakes the entire covenant-labor system, and therefore the most suppressed sentence in the canon. Abolitionist cells stencil it on OSO walls.
Do not oppress the escaped slave
He chooses his own residence 'where it liketh him best'; suppressed with its twin — the two-verse abolition the regime pretends is about foreign slaves only.
